data.name: Mahindokht
data.gender_notes: Mahindokht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Mahindokht is of Persian origin, derived from the Persian words maḥ (moon) and hind (light). It symbolizes the moon's gentle and radiant light, which illuminates the night and inspires awe and wonder. In Islam, this name carries spiritual significance as a reminder of Allah's blessings and guidance. The name Mahindokht carries the meaning “Moon's light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahindokht usually hope their child will grow to embody moon's light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
